subject: SIG Vendor Questionnaire: MedicalCo — Follow-up & Clarifying Questions
messages:
From: Camila Reyes <camila@redwood.com>
To: Samantha Lee <samantha.lee@medicalco.com>, Rajiv Menon <rajiv.menon@medicalco.com>
Cc: Nikhil Sharma <nikhil@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-05-30T09:15:00-07:00
Subject: Post-call recap + SIG initiation (MedicalCo)

Hi Samantha / Rajiv —

Great to meet earlier — thanks for the time. Quick recap from our discovery call and next steps to get your security team what they need: 

Summary:
- Use case: MedicalCo will evaluate Redwood for secure, low-latency inference for clinical decisioning (PHI ingestion for model-assisted triage).
- Scope: Pilot ingesting de-identified and, in some flows, identified PHI.
- Timeline: Aim to start a technical POC in July; security review in June.

Immediate next steps I can action today:
1) Initiate SIG questionnaire (attached) to capture controls baseline. Please see attached "MedicalCo_SIG_Request_20270530.pdf" from your side — I attached Redwood's starter response stub (redwood_sig_response_stub.xlsx) to speed things up.
2) Confirm whether a BAA is required (flagged on the call). If yes, we can share our BAA template.
3) Clarifying questions (please answer below where possible so our security team can triage):
   a) SOC 2 status: Do you require SOC 2 Type II evidence? If so, do you need current OR historical reports?
   b) Data residency: Will data be restricted to US regions only? Any EU residency needs?
   c) PHI handling: Will MedicalCo send raw PHI, or will you apply de-identification/tokenization before sending?
   d) KMS/keys: Do you require BYOK (bring-your-own-key) or can we manage keys (we use customer-segregated KMS scopes for Private deployments)?

Would you be able to share the completed SIG/CAIQ or note any custom controls up front? To make this fast, I've attached our stubbed answers and our BAA template — happy to iterate. 

Proposed: once we have your completed SIG, Nikhil (cc'd) will run through the answers and schedule a short security sync next week. Marissa (CS) will coordinate the POC logistics after the security pass.

Thanks —
Camila Reyes
Enterprise Sales | Redwood Inference
camila@redwood.com | +1 (415) 555-0132

Attachments:
- redwood_sig_response_stub.xlsx (response stub)
- redwood_baa_template.docx (BAA template)

From: Samantha Lee <samantha.lee@medicalco.com>
To: Camila Reyes <camila@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-05-30T11:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Post-call recap + SIG initiation (MedicalCo)

Hi Camila —

Thanks for the recap and for initiating this. I attached our SIG request PDF (MedicalCo_SIG_Request_20270530.pdf) — it includes the custom controls our security team cares about. High-level answers to your clarifying questions below: 

- SOC 2: We currently do not have SOC 2 Type II. We are evaluating vendors who have Type II or can provide compensating controls; receiving a SOC 2 report is preferred, but our security team can also accept completed SIG/CAIQ responses and evidence.
- BAA: Yes, MedicalCo handles PHI. We will require a BAA prior to production.
- Data residency: US only for production data. For the POC, we can use US regions as well.
- PHI handling: For the POC we plan to send de-identified records; production may send limited identifiers.
- KMS: We generally prefer vendor-managed keys for pilots; for production we may require BYOK.

A couple of clarifying questions from our side:
1) How does Redwood handle ingestion of PHI in the hosted offering vs. Dedicated/Private? Any difference in access controls or logging?
2) Is there a way to minimize retention on Redwood side (short retention window) or request on-demand purging for the POC?

I'm available next week Tue/Wed afternoon PT for a 30-min follow-up.

Thanks,
Samantha Lee
Security Program Manager | MedicalCo
samantha.lee@medicalco.com

Attachment:
- MedicalCo_SIG_Request_20270530.pdf

From: Camila Reyes <camila@redwood.com>
To: Samantha Lee <samantha.lee@medicalco.com>
Cc: Nikhil Sharma <nikhil@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-05-30T12:40:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Post-call recap + SIG initiation (MedicalCo)

Samantha — really appreciate the fast responses and the SIG PDF.

We hear you on the SOC 2 and BAA requirements. Next steps from our side: 
- Nikhil (cc) will take point on the SIG/controls and follow up with any evidence requests.
- I'll share a short BAA template (attached) and our recommended POC data handling approach.
- Marissa (cc) will schedule the POC kickoff once security clears the baseline — she can also coordinate a non-production env with minimized retention.

Nikhil — can you start with the SIG stub attached and call out any controls we need evidence for? Samantha — I've also included a Calendly link for 30 minutes if you want us to walk through the SIG together: https://calendly.com/camila-redwood/30min

I'll plan to follow up with a proposed schedule for the POC after security confirms the baseline.

Best,
Camila

Attachments:
- redwood_sig_response_stub.xlsx
- redwood_baa_template.docx

From: Nikhil Sharma <nikhil@redwood.com>
To: Samantha Lee <samantha.lee@medicalco.com>
Cc: Camila Reyes <camila@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-05-31T11:02:00-07:00
Subject: Re: SIG Vendor Questionnaire: MedicalCo — clarifying questions

Hi Samantha / Camila / Marissa —

Thanks — I'm starting our SIG/CAIQ review and I have a few quick clarifying questions that will help speed evidence collection: 

1) Data types: for the POC, can you confirm the top-level categories (e.g., clinical notes, diagnoses, HL7 fields, images)? We primarily need to know if there are binary objects (images) that need special handling.
2) Retention: you mentioned minimized retention for the POC — what window would you expect (24h, 7 days, 30 days)? We can set short retention for Dedicated/Private and can request on-demand purge for Hosted but there are different SLAs.
3) PHI in prompts: will MedicalCo send raw PHI in prompts, or will you prefer tokenization/pseudonymization at source? This affects KV cache handling and redaction controls.
4) KMS/BYOK: for production BYOK is supported on our Dedicated and Private plans. For the hosted pilot we recommend vendor-managed keys (we segregate keys per-customer). Any preference for pilot vs prod?

If you can reply with short answers to 1-4, I will attach the relevant evidence (configuration screenshots, KMS architecture diagram, and our SOC 3/SSAE references where applicable) to the SIG response. We can also jump on the Calendly time if you prefer to review live.

Thanks —
Nikhil Sharma
Security & Compliance | Redwood Inference
nikhil@redwood.com

Attachments (to follow): redwood_kms_architecture.pdf, redwood_evidence_index.xlsx
